The '''Anchor''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] at [[the Beach]] or from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It also has a chance to appear inside [[Artifact Trove]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Tailoring==
The Anchor is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Captain's Uniform]].  [[File:Shirt239.png|24px]]

==Quests==
The Anchor is not used in any [[quests]].
